summary: This document records the Iceberg Spark integration updates, covering new features such as DSv2 validation, geometry bounds in Parquet writers, and runtime filtering improvements, along with bug fixes for ORC variant handling and vectorized reads. Kevin Liu raises the question of whether Iceberg V4 should cease writing new ORC and Avro files due to feature gaps, while still supporting reads for backward compatibility. Benchmarks indicate that conversion is quick for sequential IDs but can be costly for random UUID keys, suggesting the use of a secondary index for large tables. The proposal is to adopt a per‑field resolution rule—using an embedded ID when present and falling back to the name mapping otherwise—aligning with the Column Projection specification.
